= 1 hour (moving time) However, we're looking for the actual moving time. Since we know the train stopped for 25 minutes, it didn't move during that time. So if the train was traveling for 1 hour and 35 minutes total but stopped for 25 minutes, the actual moving time would be: 1 hour (total moving time) - 25 minutes (stop time)
= 45 minutes
